title: Select the background key window before typing
problem: Background browser keys did not reach their intended window.
change: Select the background key window and retain truthful refusals for unsafe Electron token typing.

title: Refresh browser titles after they change
problem: Browser metadata could retain a stale title.
change: Refresh browser metadata so the reported title follows the current page.

title: Control logged-in Chrome and organize its tabs
problem: Remote debugging ports could not use the ordinary profile and could activate Chrome.
change: Connect the installed extension to the browser engine for background page input and tab organization.

title: Recognize file pickers as part of their parent window
problem: Native Chrome file pickers failed exact-window focus checks.
change: Map sheets to their parent and allow 150 ms for attached-sheet input readiness.

title: Avoid restarting Chromium accessibility before it is ready
problem: Reasserting accessibility at two seconds restarted Chromium's own tree debounce.
change: Reassert only once content is present.

title: Explain when a covered browser has no page tree
problem: A cold covered Chrome window withheld its page accessibility tree.
change: Report the missing web content instead of inventing controls.

title: Make Electron scrolling work
problem: Scrolling in Electron needed repair after the driver update.
change: Restore the measured Electron scrolling behavior on the updated driver.

title: Use the connected extension as route-specific consent
problem: The linked extension still required a separate broad existing-profile grant.
change: Treat a connected extension as consent for its relay route only.

title: Send rename keys to Finder child editors
problem: Rename keys were refused because Finder's editor was a separate WindowServer child.
change: Keep exact IDs but recognize their verified parent-child membership.

title: Restore focus after delayed app activation
problem: The no-overlay observer did not fire and duplicate restores were slow and ineffective.
change: Run the activation observer, restore through one focus lease, and guard stale events and user input.

title: Deliver foreground shortcuts with real modifier flags
problem: A shortcut said it was pressed while the intended app received no paste.
change: Use physical modifier flags and verified exact activation.

title: Return actions without waiting for a new window
problem: Every action waited a second for a window that usually never appeared.
change: Return immediately, keep bounded focus protection, and report new panels on the following read.

title: Retain ancestor context around queried controls
problem: A narrow control query hid the group needed to interpret the result.
change: Keep relevant ancestor groups in queried output.

title: Keep screenshot and input coordinates aligned
problem: Screen points and screenshot pixels can refer to different locations.
change: Align screenshot coordinates with the points used for input.

title: Return actual field text in checked action sequences
problem: Sequences could report placeholders as field values and needed compatible typing verification.
change: Read actual field values, preserve empty strings, and verify sequence typing through the live field.

title: Load discarded browser tabs only on request
problem: A read of an unloaded tab could silently trigger unwanted browser work.
change: Refuse reads of unloaded tabs and provide an explicit action to load them.

title: Keep control numbers stable and return window changes
problem: Repeated full window trees forced agents to reread unchanged information.
change: Keep stable AX row identities and return a diff only for comparable observations.

title: Keep permission identity stable across rebuilds
problem: Ad-hoc builds left stale permission rows that made granted access appear unavailable.
change: Use a stable signing certificate and warn when the installed app has an ad-hoc identity.

title: Keep telemetry state isolated between tests
problem: Telemetry state could interfere with repeatable test outcomes.
change: Isolate telemetry state so tests do not affect one another.

title: Expose focused text selection
problem: Agents lacked the selected-text context needed to replace or confirm text.
change: Add focused text-selection output and restore its deferred checks.

title: Reject text insertion claims without reliable readback
problem: Pre-existing text or a silent AX write could be mistaken for new insertion.
change: Confirm inserted text through the retained editor, selection and prepared live field.

title: Recognize actions that replace their own control
problem: A working action looked unsuccessful when its control disappeared.
change: Report the action as performed when it replaced its own element.

title: Return to the intended window after a menu command
problem: Menu commands could leave the wrong window active.
change: Restore the menu window after delivery.

title: Reuse session labels after disconnect
problem: A closed connection could leave its session label unavailable.
change: Release ownership safely so a later connection can reuse the label.

title: Resolve the app and window from a control token
problem: Agents needed to repeat app and window identifiers already carried by a token.
change: Resolve the target from the token alone.

title: Batch actions and read once
problem: Agents spent extra model turns on individual desktop actions.
change: Run up to eight actions with one final read and wait before key steps after editing.

title: Send smaller element records
problem: Large structured element records increased Claude input cost.
change: Use compact element records by default.

title: List the current Space by default
problem: Window lists included irrelevant off-Space windows.
change: Default to the current Space and report omitted windows.

title: Shorten tool descriptions
problem: Tool discovery repeatedly returned long descriptions.
change: Move detail into documentation and shorten the tool list.

title: Repair window targeting after the upstream update
problem: The upstream sync introduced menu-window and sibling-window regressions.
change: Restore menu-window targeting and foreground clicks in sibling windows.

title: Teach agents to act and read in one call
problem: Claude often clicked and then requested a separate window read.
change: Name act and read in the server instructions.

title: Address an app by name
problem: Agents needed extra discovery calls to find an app window.
change: Resolve an unambiguous app name and return input readiness.

title: Release background Command chords exactly once
problem: Catalyst treated Command-bearing key-up as a held shortcut and repeated it.
change: Remove Command from the background key-up flags.

title: Align the visible cursor tip with the click target
problem: The cursor tip was offset from the actual target.
change: Use the cursor theme hotspot and scale the PiP sprite.

title: Omit duplicate element records by default
problem: Agents received both an outline and redundant element data.
change: Use token-addressable outline text without default element records.

title: Show live frames in the window preview
problem: The stream started but discarded every frame because of a bridge conversion bug.
change: Read the frame status directly through CoreMedia.

title: Keep capture work off the action path
problem: PiP capture and overlay scheduling blocked actions and cursor updates.
change: Move capture to its own workers and run the cursor overlay loop.

title: Show completion from recorded checks
problem: A green check needed to represent satisfied checks rather than assumptions.
change: Key completion evidence by event time and predicate identity.

title: Make preview controls appear on hover
problem: A permanent frame and header distracted from the live window picture.
change: Use a frameless card with a glass hover bar and visible controls.

title: Stop stale captures recreating closed previews
problem: A late frame could reopen an ended session or show the previous target image.
change: Discard ended-session captures and clear stale pictures on target changes.

title: Show recent windows in a resizable preview stack
problem: The preview could show only one window during multi-window work.
change: Add a stack, spring following, resizing and back-card selection.

title: Batch the browser share flow
problem: Filling a small browser form required repeated calls and large snapshots.
change: Add checked browser steps with stable references and compact diffs.

title: Complete the browser share task in two calls
problem: Model agents spent calls binding the browser and recovering from session errors.
change: Bind and read together, support implicit sessions and match named steps.

title: Repair browser consent and session handling
problem: Browser actions could misroute or lose the session after reconnecting.
change: Repair grant recovery, window binding, typing readback, key aliases and debugger lifetime.

title: Limit enhanced accessibility to Chromium apps
problem: The driver enabled Chromium-specific accessibility in unrelated apps.
change: Apply enhanced accessibility only to Chromium and Electron.

title: Verify the target window and row before claiming a click
problem: Foreground clicks could miss their exact window or claim an unverified row action.
change: Raise the exact target or refuse, read selection back and validate advertised actions.

title: Show the browser window an action actually touched
problem: Browser actions could use a browser-internal window number or create empty previews.
change: Use the selected tab's proven macOS window and create a panel only after capture succeeds.

title: Fit the preview and show completion after verification
problem: The preview distorted window shapes and showed completion during thinking pauses.
change: Fit the preview to the window and show completion only after verification or session end.

title: Keep the preview stable while the user handles it
problem: The preview vanished during dragging and the agent overrode user card picks.
change: Hold it during interaction, preserve a picked card and clamp release to the screen.

title: Crop browser previews and let them reach screen edges
problem: Browser previews included browser controls and stopped short of screen edges.
change: Crop the preview to the page and let its card reach the screen edges.

title: Keep the preview visible throughout an agent turn
problem: The preview faded during long model thinking pauses.
change: Use transport-owned turn hooks, quiet interruption cleanup and a bounded inactivity lease.

title: Move previews aside so clicks can reach their targets
problem: The driver's own preview could block the target of its click.
change: Hide crossed previews during a gesture and wait or refuse while the user holds one.

title: Explain typing limits and incomplete window reads
problem: Text writes could miss app behavior, and incomplete reads could hide relevant content.
change: Refuse unsafe text writes, give a typing recovery route, and identify incomplete window reads.

title: Report text insertion only after readback
problem: Typing could report success without the requested text appearing.
change: Use trusted readback and require focused key input for Catalyst text views.

title: Expose browser controls and send the final Enter
problem: Ignored wrappers hid browser controls and text entry could omit the final Enter.
change: Keep controls under ignored wrappers, derive missing names, and send Enter after trailing newlines.

title: Select Catalyst list rows with one verified action
problem: A row click returned success without selecting the item.
change: Press the row's hit-tested content and verify selected children before escalating.

title: Refresh app identities after an app relaunch
problem: The app list retained a Chrome process after relaunch.
change: Enumerate live process IDs and read the real front process.

title: Reduce tool-loading overhead
problem: Repeated tool discovery and long definitions inflated model input.
change: Preload core Claude tools and project compact Codex results.

title: Handle native file names, toggles and menus correctly
problem: File-name writes, toggles, menus and pop-up fields had misleading results or refusals.
change: Refuse uncommitted file renames, verify toggles and pop-ups, match menu ellipses, and close menus when a path fails.

title: State the observed result of each action
problem: Agents reread because action receipts omitted selection, save or rename outcomes.
change: Add concise outcome lines from independently watched window facts.

title: Keep stacked cards reachable at the edges
problem: Back cards disappeared off-screen and the top resize band was blocked.
change: Flip the stack near edges, repair the resize band and retain known page crops.

title: Avoid permission prompts from bare test builds
problem: Every debug build could register a new permission identity and prompt the host.
change: Avoid bare-build responsibility relaunch and prompting, and clean up test daemons.

title: Describe Catalyst action outcomes accurately
problem: Catalyst rows and steppers could produce misleading change descriptions.
change: Correct the watched facts and outcome wording for Catalyst controls.

title: Report pending Finder edits and keep editors open
problem: AX text could change while the actual file metadata remained unsaved.
change: End multiline edits, mark one-line edits pending until Return or Tab, and keep Finder in front while its editor is open.

title: Finish browser clicks sooner and support page drags
problem: Page drags were unavailable and same-page navigation kept clicks waiting after the route had finished.
change: Add checked page double-clicks and drags, and finish the click wait when same-page navigation completes.

title: Merge the upstream driver without losing fork behavior
problem: The fork had fallen behind upstream and contained overlapping fixes.
change: Merge the pinned upstream tip, resolve topic conflicts and verify the installed build.

title: Open and reuse app windows without stealing focus
problem: Launching or reusing app windows could bring them forward or omit the requested window.
change: Avoid duplicate launches, identify requested and reused windows, and report observed activation.

title: Name the app displaced by bringing another app forward
problem: Agents brought an app forward and forgot to return the user's app.
change: Include the displaced app in results and explain how to return to it.

title: Return the user's app after a file panel closes
problem: Save and Open panels left another app in front at task end.
change: Extend the front lease to panel steps and return the displaced app after closure.

title: Return to the user app after a Finder edit closes
problem: Finder stayed in front after an edit ended, and restoration could overwrite a deliberate app switch.
change: Return to the displaced app after the edit closes only while the restoration is still valid.

title: Run supported menu commands in the background
problem: Menu commands unnecessarily activated the target app.
change: Try a supported background menu route and explain why foreground fallback is needed.

title: Read pages without opening an Automation prompt
problem: Reading a page opened an Automation prompt and left the prompt in front of the user.
change: Check permission without prompting and identify the accessibility fallback in the result.

title: Make release builds work with the new macOS SDK
problem: Rust stripping produced misaligned Mach-O string tables that the new loader rejected.
change: Update the Rust toolchain pin and matching CI pins to produce correctly aligned release binaries.

title: Keep previews on the right windows through completion
problem: The preview showed wrong windows, expired cards, duplicate finishes and overlapping panels.
change: Track the acted window, retain and size cards for the turn, keep panels apart, and hold completion for 30 seconds.

title: Keep background work from displacing the user's app
problem: Hosted fields received keys in the wrong process, and focus cleanup could displace the user.
change: Route keys to the nearest field owner and retain protected focus and cleanup through nested input work.

title: Return a full read when window diffs are incomplete
problem: Different walk coverage could falsely look like removed controls or no change.
change: Require both old and current reads to prove complete coverage, otherwise return a full observation.

title: Respect the user's app switch during input preparation
problem: Preparation could undo a user's switch to the target app.
change: Respect a recorded switch before restoration.

title: Run each menu command only once
problem: A delayed visible effect caused the driver to paste or create a document twice.
change: Never press a menu item again after delivery, even if its visible effect is delayed.

title: Return sooner after a click with no visible change
problem: An inert click spent most of its time waiting for a change that never arrived.
change: Use a 400 ms no-change window for pointer clicks and tell the caller to read before repeating.

title: Move the cursor quickly before distant clicks
problem: Distance-based cursor movement added about two seconds before distant clicks.
change: Use a fixed 120 ms default cursor glide at any distance, while preserving explicit overrides.

title: Give mouse events fresh times and correct positions
problem: Injected clicks carried stale timestamps, and refreshing them exposed a window-position offset.
change: Stamp mouse events with current machine uptime at dispatch and use window-local click coordinates.

title: Make the preview cursor smaller
problem: The minimum cursor size made it about three times too large for a small preview.
change: Lower the preview cursor minimum from 10 pt to 7 pt.

title: Place previews at the final drag release point
problem: Fast preview drags stopped one event short of the release point.
change: Read each pointer event position and apply the release point to preview moves and resizes.
sample: 3 runs per build, 19 drags per run

title: Keep held clicks from reaching the wrong app
problem: Mouse taps could hold clicks until another app was restored, and web rows could receive a second action.
change: Route tap-sensitive clicks safely, wait before restoring apps, avoid web-row replay, and recognize renamed Chromium frameworks.

title: Type faster and stop safely before the client timeout
problem: Throttled typing continued after the client timed out, so a later retry could duplicate the text.
change: Use an Interactive LaunchAgent, enforce a posting deadline, and refuse typing that cannot fit the remaining time.

title: Click web rows and pass through passive overlays
problem: Unsupported accessibility presses missed web rows, and passive overlays were treated as obstructions.
change: Choose the delivery route before dispatch, wait for stable hit tests, and use the actual receiver under overlays.
